data_sync.title: Data Sync
data_sync.backup_tooltip:
Uploads a full archive containing all diaries, settings, and database to cloud storage.

• Manual Protection: Rename any backup to mark it as "Manual", keeping it permanently safe from auto-cleanup
• Auto Cleanup: When the backup limit is exceeded, only unmarked regular backups are automatically cleaned up
data_sync.snapshot_tooltip:
Automatic local snapshot created before critical operations, acting as your safety net.

• Triggers: Automatically captures current state before restoring full backups or applying other snapshots
• One-Click Rollback: Easily revert to the pre-operation state if restored data is not as expected
• Local Only: Stored safely on this device, using zero cloud storage or bandwidth
data_sync.incremental_sync_tooltip:
Syncs your diaries, chat sessions, AI companions, and settings across devices.

• Changes only: Transfers only modified files to save time and bandwidth
• Two-way sync: Additions, edits, and deletions propagate to both sides
• Independent: Stored separately from full backups without conflict
data_sync.incremental_sync_enable_warning:
Sync keeps the version with the latest file modification time and overwrites the older copy on the other side. This can cause unexpected data loss. Please make sure you understand the risk.

API keys and other sensitive settings in each vault's `.baishou/settings/` will also be synced to the cloud. Ensure your cloud storage access is properly secured.

We recommend enabling version control (Git) on desktop to protect your data. Mobile is better suited for one-way backup.
data_sync.incremental_sync_scope_notice: File-level bidirectional incremental sync: only modified files are transferred. Unchanged files consume no data; supports automatic merge after offline edits.
